candidates.name: Monzo
candidates.description: Both are leading digital-first neobanks offering personal and business accounts with integrated budgeting and spending analytics.
candidates.rationale: Monzo is a digital neobank offering consumer and business accounts, cards, payments, and money-management tools to the same users as Revolut.

candidates.name: N26
candidates.description: Both operate as mobile-only banks providing multi-currency accounts, card management, and investment features within a single app.
candidates.rationale: N26 is a mobile-first digital bank offering accounts, cards, payments, and investing to substantially overlapping users and financial needs.

candidates.name: Starling Bank Limited
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive digital banking services including personal and business accounts with real-time transaction notifications.
candidates.rationale: Starling is a digital bank offering personal and business accounts, cards, and payments to substantially the same customers and banking use cases as Revolut.

candidates.name: Wise
candidates.description: Both offer multi-currency accounts and low-cost international money transfer services as a core part of their value proposition.
candidates.rationale: Wise and Revolut both serve consumers and businesses with multi-currency accounts, international transfers, FX, and payment products.

candidates.name: Bunq +1
candidates.description: Both are European-focused digital banks that emphasize mobile-first banking, multi-currency support, and automated financial management.
candidates.rationale: Bunq is a mobile-first European digital bank offering accounts, cards, payments, and multi-currency features to overlapping consumer and business users.

candidates.name: Chime
candidates.description: Both are prominent fintech platforms offering fee-free banking, early direct deposit, and credit-building tools to retail users.
candidates.rationale: Both are consumer-focused digital banking platforms offering app-based accounts, cards, payments, and related financial tools to retail users.

candidates.name: Nubank
candidates.description: Both are massive digital banking platforms that have disrupted traditional finance by offering a full suite of financial services via a mobile app.
candidates.rationale: Nubank is a digital banking platform offering app-based cards, payments, accounts, and financial services to similar consumer and business banking users.

candidates.name: Cash
candidates.description: Both provide a mobile-centric ecosystem for peer-to-peer payments, card spending, and investment services.
candidates.rationale: Cash App similarly offers consumers a mobile financial ecosystem spanning peer-to-peer payments, card spending, and investing.

candidates.name: Lunar
candidates.description: Both offer a digital banking experience that combines traditional account features with investment and budgeting tools in one app.
candidates.rationale: Lunar is a digital banking app offering accounts, cards, budgeting, and investing, closely overlapping Revolut’s core consumer financial services and users.

candidates.name: Qonto
candidates.description: Both provide robust business banking solutions including expense management, invoicing, and multi-currency accounts for SMEs.
candidates.rationale: Qonto overlaps Revolut Business in SME digital banking, payments, cards, expense management, invoicing, and multi-currency accounts for the same business buyers.

candidates.name: Tide Platform Limited
candidates.description: Both focus on providing comprehensive financial management and banking services specifically tailored for business owners and SMEs.
candidates.rationale: Tide and Revolut both provide digital business banking, cards, payments, and financial management services to SMEs and business owners.

candidates.name: ZEN
candidates.description: Both offer multi-currency accounts and international payment solutions designed to simplify financial management for individuals and businesses.
candidates.rationale: ZEN overlaps Revolut in digital multi-currency accounts, cards, and international payments for consumers and businesses, serving the same financial-management needs.

candidates.name: SoFi
candidates.description: Both provide a wide range of financial products including banking, lending, and investment services within a single digital platform.
candidates.rationale: Both are digital financial super-apps offering consumers integrated banking, payments, and investing services for similar financial needs.

candidates.name: Current, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer mobile-first banking features such as early paycheck access, savings goals, and credit-building tools.
candidates.rationale: Current is a mobile-first neobank offering consumer banking, payments, savings, and credit tools that overlap Revolut’s core consumer financial app.

candidates.name: C6 Bank
candidates.description: Both are digital banks that provide a full suite of services including multi-currency accounts, investments, and credit cards.
candidates.rationale: C6 Bank is a digital banking platform offering cards, accounts, payments, and investments to similar consumer and business users.

candidates.name: Maya
candidates.description: Both operate as financial super-apps, combining digital banking, e-wallet payments, and investment services in one interface.
candidates.rationale: Maya is a financial super-app offering digital banking, wallet payments, cards, and investments to overlapping consumer and business users.

candidates.name: Jupiter
candidates.description: Both provide a unified mobile app experience for banking, tracking expenses, and investing in various financial assets.
candidates.rationale: Jupiter is a consumer neobanking app offering mobile banking, payments, expense tracking, and investments, overlapping Revolut’s core consumer financial super-app.

candidates.name: Aspire
candidates.description: Both offer all-in-one financial platforms for businesses, featuring multi-currency accounts and expense management tools.
candidates.rationale: Aspire overlaps Revolut Business with multi-currency business accounts, payments, cards, and expense management for the same business finance buyers.

candidates.name: Toss
candidates.description: Both function as financial super-apps that integrate payments, banking, and investment services for a seamless user experience.
candidates.rationale: Toss is a financial super-app offering consumers overlapping payments, banking, and investment services for similar financial-management needs.

candidates.name: PhonePe Group
candidates.description: Both are major digital platforms that integrate payments, money transfers, and financial services like insurance and investments.
candidates.rationale: PhonePe is a financial super-app offering digital payments, transfers, insurance, and investments, substantially overlapping Revolut’s core consumer financial-services proposition.

candidates.name: Navi Group
candidates.description: Both offer a broad range of financial services including digital banking, loans, and investments through a mobile-first platform.
candidates.rationale: Both are mobile-first financial super-apps offering consumers overlapping digital payments, banking, lending, and investment services.

candidates.name: GCash Group
candidates.description: Both serve as comprehensive financial super-apps that allow users to manage payments, savings, and investments in one place.
candidates.rationale: GCash is a financial super-app offering consumers overlapping payments, savings, and investment services, closely matching Revolut’s core model and user needs.

candidates.name: Picpay
candidates.description: Both provide digital accounts that combine payment processing, peer-to-peer transfers, and financial service offerings.
candidates.rationale: PicPay is a digital financial super-app offering accounts, payments, transfers, cards, and related services to overlapping consumer and business users.

candidates.name: Hey Banco
candidates.description: Both are digital-first banking platforms that allow users to manage their money entirely through a mobile application.
candidates.rationale: Hey Banco is a digital-first mobile banking platform offering core money-management services to the same consumer banking users as Revolut.

candidates.name: Nium, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide global cross-border payment infrastructure and multi-currency financial services for businesses and consumers.
candidates.rationale: Nium overlaps Revolut’s business offering in cross-border payments, FX, and multi-currency financial services, serving companies with the same global payments needs.
